text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය අති විෙශෂ
No. 1909/51 – FRIDAY, APRIL 10, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: GCF/Ath/KD/25/LR.
Land Min’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB/100.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government indents to acquire the land described below to be utilized for the tanks constructed in Sri Jayawardhanapura area under the Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Improvement Project.

Description of the land to be acquired: Two allotments of land in total extent of 1.5678 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 and 02 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9519 dated 20.02.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Battaramulla (within the Municipal Council limit of Kaduwela) in the Grama Niladhari division No. 491/B of Kotuwegoda in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kaduwela in Colombo District of Western Province and described as follows.
Lot No. 01
Name of the Land: Land at Kotte Road of which the assessment number could not be traced; Present Land use: Diyawanna Oya; Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 1.2213 Hectares.
Lot No. 02
Name of the Land: Land at Kotte Road of which the assessment number could not be traced; Present Land use: Home Garden; Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.3465 Hectares.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Greater Colombo Flood Control Project Office located in the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 15th May, 2015 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 8th May, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Improvement Project. Divisional Secretary’s Division, Kaduwela.
Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Improvement Project, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya. 13th March, 2015. 04 - 825

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: 3/7/3/5.

Land Ministry Reference No.: LD/05/2008/VE/34. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to the following land which is required for public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: The allotments of land in total Extent about 1.3411 shown as Lots Numbers 01 to 02 (P.P.N. 2968) situated in the village of Tennehenwala in Mulhalkele Grama Niladari Division in Divisional Secretary Division of Walapane in Nuwara Eliya District in Central province and described as follows: Lot No. 01 — Name of Land: Deneelo Waththa; Claimants: State; Original Claimants: Don Ranjith Wimalsiri Ranasingha; Description: Low Jungle; Extent: 0.6425 Hectare. Bounders: North: Lots 5 and 6 in P.P. 2559 and Road (Road Development Authority); East: Road (Road Development Authority); South: Road (Road Development Authority) and Lot 2; West: Lot 2 and Lots 14, 5 and 6 in P.P. 2559.

Lot No. 02 — Name of Land: Deneelo Waththa; Claimants: State; Original Claimants: Don Ranjith Wimalsiri Ranasingha; Description: Low Jungle; Extent: 0.6986 Hectare. Bounders: North: Lot 14 in P.P. 2559 and Lot 1; East: Lot 1 and Road (Road Development Authority); South: Road (Road Development Authority) Muthalkelewatta Claimed by G.A. Dayawathi (T.P. 51362); West: Muhalkelewatta Claimed by G.A. Dayawathi (T.P. 51362) and Lot 14 in P.P. 2559. All person interest in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office Walapane on the 06th day of May, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 30th day of April, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. I. K. G. MUTHUBANDA, Divisional Secretary, Walapane.
Divisional Secretariat, Walapane, 11th March, 2015. 04 - 826
